details:
This update for libxls fixes the following issues:

Changes in libxls:

Update to release 1.6.4:

  * Fix use of uninitialized memory in OLE parsing
    [boo#1267687, CVE-2026-26825]
  * Fix use of uninitialized memory in read_MSAT
    [boo#1267608, CVE-2026-26824]
  * Fix use of uninitialized memory in xls_parseWorkBook
  * Fix out-of-bounds reads in the formula dumper
  * Handle allocation failures in OLE, workbook and string code
  * Read SummaryInformation streams at their real size
  * Keep full precision when converting numeric cells to strings
  * Fix "creation of UTF-8 locale failed" in xls2csv

Update to release 1.6.3:

  * Fix style record size check on big-endian systems
  * Fix header include in C++ mode
  * Fix buffer overflows when parsing style records
  * Fix infinite loop with self-referencing sectors
